dct_description_sm:
This layer includes data from Statistics Canada 2021 Census of Population with a focus on Electoral Districts in the City of Kingston.  This summary highlights data based on indicators of Housing, Households and Families from the 2021 census of population.  Housing indicators describe the phyical and financial characteristics of dwellings, Household indicators refer to the characteristics of the people occupying a dwelling and Family indicators outline family structures and the relationship between household members in the City of Kingston.

Custom geography census profiles, including Electoral Districts and Neighbourhood‑level profiles, are created entirely from the long‑form (25% sample) census database. Standard geography census profiles for the Kingston CMA and CSD geographies use information from both the short‑form (100% sample) and long‑form databases, depending on the variable.

To protect respondent confidentiality, all Census data is processed using Statistics Canada’s Random Rounding method. This technique randomly adjusts numbers up or down to the nearest 0 or 5, helping ensure privacy while keeping overall results as accurate and unbiased as possible.

Because of these differences in data sources and rounding methods, users may notice that some counts do not align perfectly across variables or geographic levels.

More information on definitions and background for the Census of Population can be found here: 
https://www12.statcan.gc.ca/census-recensement/2021/ref/dict/index-eng.cfm
